texts: Changed the chat history received when joining. Previously messages over 1 hour old were removed from the history. Now the last 50 messages regardless of age will be sent. The history is still cleared regardless if the server is restarted for updates.

Removed user joined/left system events in chat to prevent them from polluting the list of messages. Instead they now show up as short floating notifs in the chat widget. They can be hidden in chat settings.
A settings button has been added to the chat widget for easier access to settings. Not all settings are included here.
Changed gifticons autocomplete to end with the closing character '}' instead of the continuing character ':' to reduce confusion.
Changed the markdown editor to only highlight the active line instead of all lines with text.
Reduced the default height of small markdown editors, including chat and sinner notes.
Reduced the maximum height of the chat widget on mobile, so it doesn't cover most of the screen.
